groups.why_chosen: Moving from exclusive, to static, to on-demand GPU allocation packs the same four training/inference functions onto fewer GPUs (4 to 3 to 2) by matching each function's actual compute request/limit instead of over- or statically provisioning it.
groups.what_to_learn: One full-width legend above three panels; identical icon chain inside each; one bold verdict line at the same y in every panel
